Foreword 
It is a great pleasure for me to write the foreword of the 
annual publication of Crime Review Tamil Nadu for the year 2022 
prepared by State Crime Records Bureau.   The SCRB has been 
bringing out its annual publication which provides extremely 
considerable 
importance 
to 
various 
stakeholders 
in 
the 
administration of Criminal Justice System.  
The book comprises of the collection of statistics of crime in 
and Students.  
The statistical information thus calls for development of 
strategies to prevent and combat crimes keeping in view their 
steps 
are 
being 
taken 
for 
both 
development 
of 
police 
infrastructure and on the legislative front to address the issue of 
reduction in crime.  
Director General of Police/ 
Tamil Nadu
